chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 444: Ji Ning Restores the Rahu Bow & Vows Vengeance on the Shao Yan Clan
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning trades the Vast Nine Orbs for a legendary bowstring, restores the Rahu Bow, and pushes the Eight-Nine Arcane Art to the fifth cycle before vowing to make the Shao Yan clan pay for their blood debt.

twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 444: Ji Ning's Ultimate Arsenal is Ready
twitter_description: Ji Ning trades a Pure Yang treasure set for a legendary bowstring, fully restores his Rahu Bow, and pushes his Eight-Nine Arcane Art to the 5th cycle. The vengeance arc begins.

lore_anchors.definition: The highest grade of manufactured Dharma treasure, above Immortal-ranked. They possess immense power and are highly sought after by True Immortals and Empyrean Gods.
A rare 'World-type' Pure Yang treasure set consisting of nine high-grade orbs and a single top-grade core orb, used to crush or imprison enemies.
Named after the legendary sage Fuxi, these staves are used to set up powerful portable formations.
A top-ten divine ability created by Daofist Threelives, allowing the user to temper their hands into weapons capable of crushing stars and shattering worlds.
A legendary divine ability granting the user an indestructible, diamond-like body. Its training requires enormous resources.
A high-grade innate spirit-treasure bow, a signature weapon of the ancient Fiendgod Rahu, known for its devastating power.
A mysterious, formless power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power. It is essential for becoming a true divine archer.
The former ruling lineage of the unified Pangu World, a supremely powerful clan of cultivators. The Xiamang clan of the Grand Xia is a diminished branch.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Eight-Nine Arcane Art?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A legendary divine ability that grants the user an indestructible, diamond-like body, but requires a massive amount of resources to train.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning trade the Vast Nine Orbs?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He traded it primarily for a legendary bowstring to restore his Rahu Bow, which is a far more valuable long-term asset for his combat style.
